summary: Nez Perce NF smokechaser cabin dated 1931 with a patrol point on Umbrella Butte; sources disagree on whether it was abandoned or burned in the 1960s.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it gone. Sources disagree on how it ended: abandoned, undated (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts), or burned in the 1960s (Forest Service list)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as hike-in

events.note: Dated 1931 by firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service list; the Idaho County page marks the year with question marks

evidence.supports: smokechaser cabin dated 1931, patrol atop Umbrella Butte 3 miles north, abandoned
evidence.quote: 1931: smokechaser cabin. Patrol atop Umbrella Butte 3 miles north. Abandoned.

evidence.supports: site is on the Nez Perce National Forest
site is in Idaho County, Idaho
Idaho County page dates the cabin 1931 with question marks
patrol point Umbrella Butte three miles north
Forest Service list says it burned in the 1960s

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the end: 'Abandoned' with no date (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) versus 'burned in 1960s' (Forest Service list). The FS list calls the building a crow's nest smokechaser cabin; the record's kind 'ground' fits 'smokechaser cabin' but should be checked against photos before the story calls it a ground cabin. Built 1931 is added as an event because the record had none. Record coordinates 45.54821,-115.94230 match FFLA; Idaho's point is about 0.001 degree away. No staffing history or fire was found, and no photo was found.
